title: Rick and Morty
description: American adult animated science fiction sitcom
wiki_lead:
Rick and Morty is an American adult animated science fiction tragicomedy sitcom created by Justin Roiland and Dan Harmon for Cartoon Network's nighttime programming block Adult Swim. The series follows the misadventures of Rick Sanchez, a cynical mad scientist, and his good-hearted but fretful grandson Morty Smith, who split their time between domestic life and interdimensional adventures that take place across an infinite number of realities, often traveling to other planets and dimensions through portals and on Rick's flying saucer. The general concept of Rick and Morty relies on two conflicting scenarios: domestic family drama and a misanthropic grandfather dragging his grandson into hijinks.
Roiland initially voiced the eponymous characters, with Chris Parnell, Spencer Grammer, and Sarah Chalke voicing the rest of Rick and Morty's family. Adult Swim cut ties with Roiland in 2023 amid allegations of domestic abuse; Ian Cardoni and Harry Belden were recast in his roles beginning with the seventh season. The series originated from an animated short parody film of Back to the Future created by Roiland for Channel 101, a short film festival Harmon co-founded. In May 2018, a long-term deal was made with Cartoon Network that ordered 70 new episodes. By November 2024, the series had been renewed through season twelve. The ninth season began airing on May 24, 2026 and concluded on July 26, 2026.
Since its debut, the series has received critical acclaim for its writing, originality, creativity, and humor. It has been nominated for three Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Animated Program and won the award twice in 2018 and 2020. It has also received two Annie Awards. At times, it has been the most viewed television comedy for adults between 18 and 24. The popularity of Rick and Morty has made it a merchandising and media franchise. A film based on the series is in development.

Premise and main characters
The show revolves around the adventures of the members of the Smith household, which consists of parents Jerry and Beth, their children Summer and Morty, and Beth's father, Rick Sanchez, who lives with them as a guest. The family lives in a suburb outside of Seattle, Washington, with the characters traveling to other planets and dimensions through portals and Rick's flying saucer.
Rick is an eccentric and alcoholic mad scientist, who eschews many ordinary conventions such as school, marriage, love, and family. He frequently goes on adventures with his 14-year-old grandson, Morty, a kind-hearted but easily distressed boy, whose naïve but grounded moral compass plays counterpoint to Rick's Machiavellian ego. Morty's 17-year-old sister, Summer, is a more conventional teenager who worries about improving her status among her peers and sometimes follows Rick and Morty on their adventures. The kids' mother, Beth, is a generally level-headed person and assertive force in the household, though self-conscious about her professional role as a horse surgeon.
grok_lead: Rick and Morty is an American adult animated science fiction sitcom created by Justin Roiland and Dan Harmon for the Cartoon Network late-night programming block Adult Swim. The series premiered on December 2, 2013, and follows the misadventures of Rick Sanchez âa nihilistic, alcoholic super-genius scientist âand his timid grandson Morty Smith as they traverse an infinite multiverse, often leading to chaotic and destructive consequences for their suburban family. Produced by Williams Street and animated primarily by Bardel Entertainment, the show has aired nine seasons, with Season 9 running from May 24 to July 26, 2026, at 11:00 p.m. ET/PT on Adult Swim, with episodes typically running 22 minutes each, and has been renewed through its twelfth season, set to conclude in 2029. Originally, Roiland provided the voices for both title characters, but following his departure after season 6 due to legal issues, the roles were recast with Ian Cardoni as Rick and Harry Belden as Morty starting in season 7. The series draws inspiration from Back to the Future, blending high-concept sci-fi with irreverent humor, philosophical undertones, and satirical commentary on society, family, and existence. Rick and Morty has achieved significant commercial success, with its third season finale in 2017 drawing 2.6 million live + same-day viewersâAdult Swim's highest-rated telecast at the timeâand consistently ranking among the top animated series in the 18-49 demographic. Critically acclaimed for its inventive storytelling and voice performances, including those by Chris Parnell as Jerry Smith, Spencer Grammer as Summer Smith, and Sarah Chalke as Beth Smith, the show has garnered multiple awards, including two Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Animated Program (for episodes from 2018 and 2020) and five Emmy nominations overall. Its cultural impact is evident in viral phenomena like the 2017 Szechuan sauce promotion tied to a season 3 episode, which sparked widespread memes and fan events, underscoring the series' influence on internet culture and pop media.
